name: Geretsried (Germany)
description: Vertical tricolour of white, light blue and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Geretsried (a blue wavy bend between a cogwheel and a fir tree on white).
history: Municipal flag of Geretsried; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Geretsried arms — wavy bend, cogwheel and fir tree on white
